cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You asked me to move a box. I've moved this one beside the van. All done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Happy to move all twenty beside it. That completes the revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need to be inside the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put them just inside the doors. You didn't ask me to leave room for the sofa.

mechanism: A claims professional scope precision while fulfilling moving requests at their narrowest boundaries, correcting each expanded instruction as a new specification already met in the smallest way.
confusable: D41 redefines unfinished work as a thoughtful product; D47 hinges specifically on literal limits of an agreement and claims full compliance with those words.
comparison: Watering alternative narrows quantity and timing; box alternative narrows count, location and usable space.
seedUse: One/all boxes and outside/inside van derive from D47-a; S03 adds exact scope corrections rather than general laziness.
